pages.title: Holding the Tear
pages.text: I stopped fighting the leak and gave it somewhere to go. I built a room to concentrate it, amethyst above and below the heart, fire to keep the air burning, glass to watch through.
At its center, the $(item)Distortion Matrix$(). A core that drinks the distortion instead of letting it escape. It holds up to $(thing)100,000 DE$(), but only while its room stands.

pages.name: Distortion Chamber
pages.text: The matrix between the amethyst, a $(l:energy/wormholes)crystal$() on the roof.

pages.title: The Room
pages.text: Stone bricks and glass for the walls, glowstone and campfires for the light, amethyst above and below the matrix, the crystal on top.$(br2)When it woke, the amethyst hardened into diamond and the fires burned blue with souls.

pages.title: Feeding It
pages.text: Lapis feeds it best. A single stone gives 100 DE, a block of it 900, and the matrix burns through 100 DE a second. I drop the fuel through its window, or let a hopper do it while I sleep. The stones float around the heart until their turn.

pages.title: Watching It
pages.text: I read its store in its window, or on its walls when I look closely.$(br2)Alchemists of other lands swear by other fuels. Perhaps their world burns differently.$(br2)Much later, the $(l:corruption/upgrades)void$() taught me to push it further.
